description:
Since its founding in 1921, the Communist Party of China (CPC) has grown from just over 50 members to the world's largest governing party, with over 100 million members.
How does a party of this scale ensure strict self-governance? What measures has it put in place, and what results has it delivered?
title: Building a strong Party for a strong China

author: New China TV
description:
"I love #FurongTown!"
Known for its spectacular #waterfall and ancient streets, Furong Town in China's #Hunan is not only a social media sensation, but also a magnet for global travelers.
The appeal goes beyond the waterfall, some visitors say they come to discover a different side of #China.
#TrendyChina #VisitChina #ChinaTravel
title: Trendy China | China's viral waterfall town embraces global visitors

author: New China TV
description:
Built over 2,200 years ago, Qinzhidao, or the "Qin Straight Road," was one of ancient China's earliest major roads, often likened to an ancient "expressway."
A strategically important military route, it was built on the orders of Emperor Qinshihuang, who unified China for the first time.
This massive undertaking played a significant role in the unification and development of ancient China.
Join us as we explore this remarkable feat of ancient engineering, uncover the stories behind it, and see how it has been preserved and brought back to life in modern times. #China #QinStraightRoad #Qinshihuang
title: Hiking along an ancient engineering marvel: China's 2,200-year-old "Qin Straight Road"

title: Xinhua News | G20 FM meeting ends without joint communique amid deep divisions

description: Rare footage captures 6 Bryde's whales feeding together off Weizhou Island, south China. With over 70 individual whales tracked in these waters over the years, it's home to one of the largest known coastal populations of its kind in the world.
title: Rare footage shows 6 Bryde's whales feeding off Weizhou Island, south China
